item.tib: rigs bdag 'od snang mtha' yas kyi bar do gsum gyi ngo sprod
item.coloph: ces pa'i 'od chog la sbyar du mkho ba'i tshe 'das ngo sprod nyung 'dus zhig 'bri dgos zhes pa/ mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang / dbal sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin/ drang srong tshul khrims mchog rgyal/ rang slob g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas ngo sprod spyi nas nyung 'dus su bsdus pa'o//
